results.title: The provisional 48-hour threshold is gone: READINESS_STALE_HOURS no longer exists
A check-in from 00:00:00 today is fresh at 23:59:59 the same local day (almost 24 h old)
Midnight: a check-in from 23:59 is stale at 00:01 the next local day, although only two minutes old
A check-in 30 hours old is stale (the old 48-hour rule called it fresh); one from the previous evening is stale the next morning
Earlier today is fresh at any time of day (checked at every hour for a morning check-in)
Live midnight transition in the app: Home is GREEN at 23:59:50, and STALE after midnight when the app is brought back to the foreground, with no user action
Left open across midnight with no focus event: the app schedules its own refresh for the next local midnight
Missing, null, empty, invalid, NaN or non-text timestamps are "never checked in" and never throw
Legacy date shapes: date-only strings are LOCAL calendar days (not UTC), zone-less ISO strings are local, epoch milliseconds work
Time-zone change: the calendar day is judged in the device's CURRENT zone (same saved instant, different verdicts)
A saved check-in on a LATER local day than now (clock or time-zone change) is flagged "future", never fresh and never "never"
Small clock skew: up to five minutes ahead the same day is accepted; two hours ahead is "future"
Daylight-saving changes: the 25-hour fall-back day and the 23-hour spring-forward day are still one calendar day each
Age is counted in calendar days, not 24-hour blocks: yesterday evening is "1 day", three days ago is "3 days" even across DST
A historical check-in stays visible but labelled: Home, Readiness page and Coach Handoff all say STALE and give the age; none presents it as today's status
A restrictive joint flag from an earlier day is still shown (restrict-only), labelled stale, until the check-in is updated
Saving a check-in today makes it current immediately; it becomes stale at the next local midnight
The readiness scoring formula and the GREEN/YELLOW/RED thresholds are unchanged for all 3,125 possible check-ins
Readiness is only ever presented through the freshness gate: readinessDecision has exactly one caller (readinessStatus)
Freshness evaluation never writes or alters stored readiness data
Legitimate comparison text ("<10:00", ">8:30/mi", "HR <140 bpm", ...) typed into cardio fields through the UI is saved exactly as typed
Round trip: a cardio entry containing < and > exports, previews, restores into a clean profile and is byte-identical
Every LEGIT string passes backup validation as a cardio value, in every cardio field
HTML-like cardio text is refused when logging, with a message explaining that < and > are allowed as comparison signs, and nothing is stored
Malicious cardio text in a backup file is refused at preview: restore is never offered, the reason names the cardio entry and field, and storage is untouched
Stored markup that predates this fix is never executed or turned into elements: the cardio "PREVIOUS" line shows it as literal text
Data keys in a cardio record must be plain identifiers: markup, control characters, __proto__ and over-long keys are refused on import
Cardio values must be text or numbers: nested objects, arrays, booleans and non-finite numbers are refused; data must be an object
Control characters and over-long text in cardio values are still refused
Import protection elsewhere is NOT weakened: < or > is still refused in work-set, stretch, strength and activator history and in record ids/names/machine fields
Historical cardio records (old shapes without id or sessionId, numeric-looking text, empty values, unknown keys) still import and round-trip byte-identically
Existing cardio records are never altered: loading, rendering, exporting and a refused import leave pa_cardio_hist byte-identical
A draft with a typed-but-unsaved cardio value containing < resumes with it after reload, and survives backup/restore
Every place that renders cardio history is escaped: static check that no cardio value reaches innerHTML unescaped
Unfinished markup with no closing ">" is plain text: accepted, stored as typed and rendered literally and inertly
A full real workflow with cardio containing < and > still passes every other backup property: draft, finished session, history all restore identically
Every one of the 29 templates has an explicit, reviewed classification: the model table matches the app exactly
Giant C ("OPTIONAL • CAPABILITY") counts as Capability only, and not as Strength or Hypertrophy
The six templates whose purpose the source does not settle are not forced into any category: they add nothing to the six bars
Completed sessions that have no category are reported, not silently dropped: budgetUnclassified() lists them by template
Unclassified reporting follows the same rules as the budget: drafts, sessions older than 7 days and unknown templates are handled, legacy "completed" status counts
Training Budget page tells the athlete when sessions are not counted: it names them and says the bars exclude them; with none, no extra line appears
Coach Handoff carries the same disclosure so an exported summary never implies the bars are the whole week
Classification is read-only and budgetData still returns exactly the six existing keys (no consumer sees a changed shape)
Source grounding is checkable: each reviewed template's own title/purpose line and block membership are what the model table was derived from
Legacy sessions (no completion field) read as "unknown: finished before completion was recorded"; reading never writes or back-fills
Full Giant A (normal week): every shown set logged -> prescription full, all exercises performed, prescribed equals the unchanged Full Session set total
ONE logged set out of a full Giant A is partial, never full; earlier unlogged movements are skipped, later ones not reached; performed counts only the real record
Finished with a checked item but no lifting records: prescription none, session still completes and still counts
Deliberate gap vs interruption: movement 1 skipped between logged movements; movements after the last logged one are not reached
A one-set prescription is never full (synthetic: Giant B reduced to the single-set Widowmaker, its only set logged)
Busy week: scope "busy", prescription measured against the busy cap (<=2 sets per movement), full when all shown sets are logged
Compact: scope "compact", only the shown movements are judged, and a complete compact session is full-in-scope, labelled compact (never presented as a Full Session)
Sets logged outside the shown scope (movement hidden by switching to compact afterwards) are recorded as extra and never counted as performed
Checklist template (Mobility): units are the items shown at Finish, not every key ever rendered; 1 item = partial, all items = full
Backup round trip: completion survives export, validation and restore byte-for-byte; sessions without it still validate
Validator bounds: malformed, oversized, contradictory or markup-bearing completion is refused with a specific message
Labels: the Finish panel previews the result before saving, and the saved notice repeats it with the not-logged movements; nothing else on screen is redesigned
Coach Handoff: "Completed sessions: N" is unchanged; a completion line separates full / partial / none / not recorded (legacy)
Session counts, Giant B rotation and budget exposure are unchanged by completion (characterization; rotation/exposure gating awaits approval D1/D5)
Evidence engine unchanged: a one-set partial session still contributes to the exercise series (characterization; gating awaits approval D4)
Historical data is never altered: legacy sessions and all prior records are byte-identical after a new session is finished
Lifecycle stays two-valued: only draft and complete are ever written; "abandoned" is refused on restore (not supported)
